description: A PHPUnit test case class for the ScssHelper class within the OrangeHRM Corporate Branding Service plugin. It contains tests for methods like darken, lighten, rgba, and color validation.

classes.name: ScssHelperTest
classes.description: Test suite for the ScssHelper class, testing its color manipulation methods.

methods.name: testDarken
methods.description: Tests the darken method of ScssHelper with different color inputs and percentages.

methods.name: testLighten
methods.description: Tests the lighten method of ScssHelper with different color inputs and percentages.

methods.name: testRgba
methods.description: Tests the rgba method of ScssHelper, converting hex colors to rgba strings with given alpha values.

methods.name: testIsColor
methods.description: Tests the isValidColor method of ScssHelper with various color string formats and invalid inputs.
